narrative: The small leaf has not grown. The light is poorer. No candle yet. The packet, edges only. No leaf pulled out of it. Ink on the forefinger from the morning, dry. The desk from a step back. Note, packet, letter. The cloak is on the peg again. Nothing is in the hand.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
